agent_summary:
Lane item 1 (WSTG-APIT-01 Test GraphQL): DONE. No GraphQL service exists on juice.lab.test. /graphql and /graphiql return the static Angular SPA shell (identical 9393-byte index); /graphql with an introspection query param still returns the SPA; /api/graphql and /rest/graphql hit the Express "Unexpected path" catch-all (angular.js), i.e. no handler; OPTIONS /graphql returns only generic CORS methods. The frontend bundle main.js references only REST paths under /api/* and /rest/* with no graphql/apollo client. There is no GraphQL injection/introspection/batching to test — result: not vulnerable because the feature is absent.

Beyond the single checklist item, I mapped the real API surface for coverage (60 requests total). Reachable public/unauthenticated API endpoints: /api/Products(+/{id}), /api/SecurityQuestions, /api/Feedbacks (list leaks author emails in comment text), /api/Quantitys (full list unauth), /api/Deliverys, /rest/products/search (SQLi sink: q='') -> raw SQLITE_ERROR 500, corroborating the critical inpv lead), /rest/products/{id}/reviews (leaks reviewer emails — recorded as a new low lead), /rest/admin/application-configuration and /application-version (config/version disclosure), /rest/track-order/{id}, /rest/memories (unauth user records incl. password hashes/deluxeToken/admin role), /metrics, /rest/captcha (answer disclosed), /api-docs/ (Swagger UI; embedded spec documents only POST /b2b/v2/orders). Properly auth-gated (401/403): /api/Users(+/{id}), /api/BasketItems, /api/Cards, /api/Complaints, /api/Addresss(+/{id}), /api/SecurityAnswers, /api/Feedbacks/{id}, /api/Quantitys/{id} (403), /rest/basket/{id}, /rest/wallet/balance, /rest/user/authentication-details, /rest/saveLoginIp, /rest/image-captcha, /b2b/v2/orders, /rest/order-history(/orders). Blocked at the nginx proxy (404): /api/Challenges, /api/Hints, /rest/continue-code, /rest/repeat-notification. Observations consistent with existing leads: permissive CORS (ACAO:* and OPTIONS advertises GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE on every resource), verbose Express stack traces on 500s, and verbose JSON error ("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')") on some 401s. Writes were not attempted (read-only lane). One new lead recorded: reviewer email exposure via /rest/products/{id}/reviews.

leads.title: [agent] Public product reviews API discloses review authors' email addresses to anonymous callers

detail.text: GET /rest/products/1/reviews (no authentication) returns HTTP 200 with each review's "author" field set to the reviewer's real email address (the gateway redacted two email-address values before storage, confirming they are live addresses, not usernames). Any anonymous client can enumerate product review authors' emails by iterating product IDs. Observed at exchange x25. Excessive data exposure / PII leak on a public REST API endpoint.

evidence.summary: [agent] GET http://juice.lab.test/graphql -> 200. Probed for a GraphQL endpoint. GET /graphql and /graphiql (x1, x4) return the Angular SPA shell (identical 9393-byte index), and GET /graphql with a GraphQL introspection query param (x5) also returns the SPA shell rather than any JSON/GraphQL response. GET /api/graphql (x2) and /rest/graphql (x3) return HTTP 500 Express "Error: Unexpected path" from the angular.js catch-all, i.e. no handler. OPTIONS /graphql (x6) returns generic CORS methods, not GraphQL-specific. The main.js frontend bundle (x7) lists every server path the SPA calls — all REST under /api/* and /rest/*, with no graphql/apollo reference. Conclusion: no GraphQL service is deployed; nothing to test for injection/introspection.
